# NGL.ayooluwa - Anonymous Q&A Platform

> A premium anonymous messaging experience where you can receive honest, anonymous messages from friends, followers, and fans.

## Site Information
- URL: https://ngl.aayooluwa.com
- Name: NGL.ayooluwa
- Creator: Aduwo Ayooluwa

## What is NGL.ayooluwa?
NGL.ayooluwa is an anonymous question-and-answer platform that allows users to:
- Create a personalized anonymous messaging page
- Share their unique link on social media (Instagram, TikTok, Snapchat, etc.)
- Receive anonymous messages, questions, and confessions
- View and manage messages in a private dashboard
- Pin important messages
- Customize their profile with various themes

## Core Features
1. **Anonymous Messaging**: Send messages without revealing your identity
2. **Instant Notifications**: Real-time push notifications when new messages arrive
3. **Theme Customization**: Choose from multiple premium themes (Classic, Love, Ocean, Forest, Midnight, Sunset)
4. **PWA Support**: Install as a mobile app for instant access
5. **Message Management**: Pin, search, and filter your inbox

## Pages
- `/` - Home page with app introduction
- `/login` - User login
- `/signup` - Create new account
- `/dashboard` - Authenticated user inbox and settings
- `/{username}` - Public anonymous message submission page

## Privacy & Security
- No sender tracking
- Complete anonymity for message senders
- Secure authentication via Supabase
- Users can only view messages sent to them

## Technical Stack
- Next.js 16
- React 19
- Supabase for authentication and database
- PWA enabled with offline support
- Responsive design for all devices

## Keywords
anonymous messaging, ngl clone, anonymous questions, confession app, anonymous feedback, social media, honest feedback, q&a platform
